headline: Avio Jumps 13% on Borsa Italiana After Takeover Bid from Finland's Iceye
summary: Shares of Italian aerospace company Avio rallied 13% toward €41 after Finnish satellite firm Iceye launched a takeover offer for the launcher and propulsion manufacturer.
why: Consolidation in European space launcher and satellite technology carries strategic implications for Europe's defense and aerospace independence.

impacts.name: Avio
impacts.why: Avio's stock price surged 13% toward the €41 per share offer price following Iceye's bid.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Shares jumped 13% as investors reacted to Finnish firm Iceye's acquisition offer near €41 per share.
